Ravi (Producer): Slide freeze = Tue 5pm PT. Prerecord fallback clip ready at assets/fallbacks/short-demo.mp4. OpsBot will upload if requested.

Jon (Growth): Audience routing: I'll triage product Qs, Ben will take infra. Priya will handle general questions + host.

Priya (Host): Ill open with a 60s framing, then hand to Nina for demo. Want a one-liner backup if demo latency >10s. Suggest: "Check the lightweight mode in docs."

Ben (Eng): I'll be standby for infra. Can we get a 10min window for live infra check before show? 18:30-18:40 PT works.

Ravi (Producer): Added mic-checks at 18:20 and 18:30. Green room opens 18:00. Recording + captions enabled.

Nina (Marketing): Great. Action items: (1) Slides uploaded by Tue EOD, (2) Ben confirm standby, (3) Jon to set up private slack channel for lead flags.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Green room opens in 1h" -> 1739999488.
